Crowd was one of the many moons housing mass livingspaces for the ever expanding population. This particular one was abandoned fairly early into the grand war. Ownership was transferred to the Trite Control Corporation.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Abandoned

CONDITIONS: Warm. Mildly foggy. Slightly sparse oxygen due to previous inhabitation.

FAUNA: Dominated by a few species.

> Environment

Unfinished Section

This section seems unfinished. If you're a wiki editor, please help with completing this section.


> Weather

Crowd can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

When Crowd experiences Flooded weather, the insides of the houses on the exterior will be filled with water immediately upon landing. The rest of the exterior will flood as normal.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Trial: Teach the Disloyal

This moon features a trial that generates with the Spooky Manor interior. Completing it rewards the player with scrap worth a total of at least ▮400. The specific rewards are the scrap "Diamond filled liver" and "Teach the disloyal ticket".

To complete this trial:

  1. Find three radios within the interior and interact with them to switch their channel.
  2. Find the pool room with an employee in it within the interior, interact with the red button in this room, and grab the gas canister revealed underneath the red button shortly afterward.
  3. Find the garage within the interior and use the gasoline to fuel the generator next to the car.
  4. Return to the pool room, interact with the red button again, and wait for the employee to die. The reward spawns below the dead employee.

Major Story Spoilers: Decision Aftermath

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto Crowd's exterior. If players land on Crowd in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn at the start of the day.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Inserting the "Teach the disloyal" videotape that is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on Galetry or randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Calist, Filitrios, Motra, or Trite into the projector in Galetry.

Unlocks

Narcotic: "Medicate the unwell" videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

> Lore

Teach The Disloyal Videotape

This videotape can be found on Trite, Filitrios, Motra, Calist and even sometimes within Gift Shop of Galetry.

Text ⁠
Loyalty is the foundation of a functional empire and those who are unable to keep to their loyalties must be punished. You are willing to go through fire for me, we need everyone to be like you. Find the disloyal, teach them our words and our pain and we will let you out.
